Publication statement: [Montgomery, Ala.?] : J. La Tourette, 1863.

Relief shown by hachures. Civil War salted paper maps. LC copy annotated in red showing fortifications, etc. Attachment to map: pen and ink tracing of the defenses of Mobile. "Map no. 11." "Photographed by Brown & Ogilvie." Library of Congress. Civil War maps (2nd ed.), S16. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
